description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You redirect an attack onto yourself and it misses.

Your capstone gave you a reaction back. This is what you have been meaning to do with it.

Make a melee Strike against the attacker if it is within your reach. This Strike does not count toward your multiple attack penalty. If The Answer has already triggered this round, this Strike gains a +2 circumstance bonus instead of being made — one body, two hands, and a limit on how much either can do.

cinderfall.incomplete: The bare reaction-Strike branch ships unencoded like Reactive Strike (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/class/shared/reactive-strike.json). The "+2 instead" branch reuses this class's own already-real no-second-needed-answer-fired RollOption flag (defined in deadhand.no-second-needed.json). The source wording ("gains a bonus instead of being made") is ambiguous about whether the Strike is skipped entirely or just modified -- the literal "+2 to a different roll instead" reading is built here; a reviewer should re-check the intended reading before relying on this as final.
